name: condensing-header
title: Condensing Header
description: A large title that condenses into a translucent bar, linked 1:1 to the scroll position.

useCases: A page or panel header with a large title, bar actions, and a search or filter row over scrolling content.
limitations: The title is a single line of plain text. The header must be the first thing in its scroll container.
requirements: Render it as a direct child of the scrolling content, with no clipping ancestor in between. Set scroll-padding-top on the scroller to the bar height.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/condensing-header.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
